What Does Organic Mean? NOT Acceptable in Your Green Waste Bin
Organic materials come from living
organisms. Organic materials, such as paper
and food, are easily broken down into
naturally occurring components.
Why Separate Organic Waste?
Organic recycling creates compost, a type of
natural fertilizer, which contains recycled
nutrients.
Palm fronds Bird of paradise
Organic waste recycling facilities capture
methane, a climate-warming gas and waste
decomposition byproduct, to generate power.
When added to soil, compost promotes soil
health & reduces the need for synthetic
fertilizer.
It’s the law!
Back/Self-Hauling
Succulents Treated wood
Organic recycling waivers for back/self-
haulers approved upon request.
Organic waste must be taken to an approved
organic recycling facility.
Back/self-haulers must have a permit and
maintain waste records (see city website for
an application).
